1.0.0: Components: Send Prompt, Describe Images, Generate Embeddings, Extract Document Text, Create Transcription, Create Speech, Moderate, List Models, List Voices and Make API Call.
Model dropdowns are filtered by model capability so each component only offers models the endpoint accepts.
1.1.0: New AI Agent component: model and instructions on the input port (bindable to flow variables); tools on the 'tools' port (the same port as the OpenAI and Claude agents) - any action component (fields mapped to 'Model Defined Parameter' are filled by the model), a chain of components run as one tool, a 'Tool Start' with its own description and parameters whose chain may branch and ends with 'Tool Output', or an MCP server. Thread memory with an optional data store, files as context (images to vision models, PDFs through Mistral OCR) and streaming to the chat utility. The model list offers models that support function calling.

Send Prompt: the output now has the same shape as the other AI connectors - Answer, Prompt, ID, Model, Created Timestamp, Finish Reason and Usage as top-level fields. The previous 'choices.message.content' and 'choices.finish_reason' outputs are replaced by 'answer' and 'finishReason'.
1.1.1: AI Agent: the tool calls of one turn run at the same time (calls of the same Tool Start one after the other). A Tool Start that is the only kind of tool on the port is called through the port; next to other tools it is called through its webhook URL.

AI Agent: a field of a tool mapped to the 'Prompt' variable of the 'tools' port gets the prompt the agent is answering. A Tool Output that comes after its tool call has timed out is removed from the flow state with the next message of the agent.
